As a Fresh Graduate AI Engineer, you will contribute to building AI solutions that support real business applications. This role is a strong fit for someone eager to apply academic learning and project experience in a collaborative software environment, working closely with technical teams and stakeholders to help shape practical, data-driven solutions.

Experience with data cleaning, preprocessing, feature engineering, exploratory analysis, or working with structured business datasets
Exposure to model deployment or monitoring, APIs, Docker, or cloud services
Ability to work with software engineers and help translate business needs into practical AI use cases
Based in Riyadh or elsewhere in Saudi Arabia, or Cairo or elsewhere in Egypt

r: Develop and test machine learning models for business applications and insights
